Identical method name (.get), but 301/302 redirect following is disabled by default in httpx.
requests Session.request accepts hooks= and allow_redirects=; httpx moves event_hooks to Client.__init__.
requests.Session mutates headers/hooks in-place via s.hooks['response']; httpx.Client uses event_hooks and immutable URL/Header normalization.
requests provides session.cookies.get_dict(); httpx.Cookies has no .get_dict() method and requires dict(client.cookies) or jar iteration.
Cookie persistence and response hook mutation timing differ before vs after response return.
requests uses session.get(url, stream=True) + resp.iter_content(); httpx requires `with client.stream('GET', url) as resp: resp.iter_bytes()`.
Identical method name (.close), but httpx streaming responses must be consumed/closed inside client.stream() context manager.
Identical method name, but raises requests.exceptions.HTTPError vs httpx.HTTPStatusError with distinct hierarchy and message format.
In httpx, HTTPError is the base class for all errors while HTTPStatusError is the status-code subclass (inverting requests' naming!).
Identical short name (.delete), diverges on redirect following default and body parameter support.
Identical short name (.patch), diverges on follow_redirects default and JSON whitespace serialization.
